note_signals.why: Pantrygood has values-driven, wellness, and clean-ingredient pantry shoppers who would appreciate premium California oils.
Hearthstone Goods attracts kitchen/cookware buyers motivated by gifting and quality, aligning perfectly with a $70 premium culinary gift.
Swiftcart has high-frequency, late-night, impulse convenience shoppers, whereas a $70 premium olive oil duo is a high-consideration/gift purchase.
Heartfoot sees strong gifting season uplift, aligning with the Duo's status as a highly gifted item.
Kitchenly's food-interested home-cooking audience is a strong match, though they lean convenience-first.
